facts.text: Hotel Jerome is at 330 East Main Street in downtown Aspen, within walking distance of the city's shops, galleries, restaurants and nightlife.
facts.excerpt: Hotel Jerome is located at 330 East Main Street in the heart of downtown Aspen, within walking distance of the city’s shops, galleries, restaurants and nightlife and just minutes from Aspen Mountain.

facts.text: Hotel Jerome is approximately three miles, or 15 minutes, from Aspen/Pitkin County Airport, and complimentary airport transportation is available on arrival by request.
facts.excerpt: Hotel Jerome is approximately three miles, or 15 minutes, from Aspen/Pitkin County Airport (ASE). Complimentary airport transportation is available upon arrival by request

facts.text: Hotel Jerome opened in 1889 at the height of Aspen's silver boom.
facts.excerpt: Hotel Jerome has been the social hub of Aspen since its opening in 1889 at the height of the town’s silver boom

facts.text: Hotel Jerome is the only Aspen hotel to have survived the silver crash, the long pre-ski-resort winters, and the Depression.
facts.excerpt: As the only Aspen hotel to survive the silver crash, the long pre-ski-resort winters, and the Depression

facts.text: Hotel Jerome is part of the National Register of Historic Places.
facts.excerpt:
Part of the
National Register of Historic Places
, Hotel Jerome’s history parallels that of Aspen’s.

facts.text: Hotel Jerome was built by Jerome B. Wheeler in 1889 with the vision of emulating the great European hotels of the time.
facts.excerpt:

Colorado

facts.text: Prospect is the restaurant at Hotel Jerome and is listed as Michelin Guide Recommended for 2026.
facts.excerpt:
## 2026 Michelin Guide Recommended

## Prospect

facts.text: Prospect displays custom artwork by photographer David Yarrow.
facts.excerpt: further elevated by the addition of custom artwork from world-renowned photographer David Yarrow

facts.text: Bad Harriet is Hotel Jerome's intimate cocktail bar, set beneath the historic Aspen Times building and named after Harriet Wheeler, wife of Jerome B. Wheeler.
facts.excerpt: Tucked beneath the historic Aspen Times building, Bad Harriet is Hotel Jerome’s intimate cocktail bar

facts.text: J-Bar is a 19th century bar at the hotel where cowboys and miners once rode their horses through the doors.
facts.excerpt: Cowboys and miners once rode their horses through its doors, 10th Mountain Division soldiers gathered here over pints after a day of training on the slopes

facts.text: J-Bar has an original Chinoiserie Chippendale till signed by every bartender who has worked there.
facts.excerpt: Make sure to take a peek at the original Chinoiserie Chippendale till, signed by every bartender to work at J-Bar over the years.

facts.text: Felix Roasting Co. at Hotel Jerome is its first location outside New York City.
facts.excerpt: Felix Roasting Co. has unveiled its first location outside of New York City at the historic Hotel Jerome.

facts.text: Yarrow Spa has three private treatment rooms, a co-ed relaxation room and an individual steam shower for both men and women.
facts.excerpt: Our intimate botanical spa has three private treatment rooms, a restful co-ed relaxation room to enjoy a glass of locally blended botanical tea and an individual steam shower for both men and women.

facts.text: Yarrow Spa offers an Element Bar where guests choose their own botanicals and essences to create a custom blend.
facts.excerpt: Choose your own botanicals and essences from our Element Bar to create your own custom blend.

facts.text: Pool and gym access at Hotel Jerome are exclusive to guests staying on property.
facts.excerpt: Pool and gym access are exclusive to guests staying on property at Hotel Jerome.

facts.text: Hotel Jerome has an on-property ski concierge, ski storage and complimentary shuttle service for the four Aspen Snowmass mountains.
facts.excerpt: Hotel Jerome makes it easy to experience all four Aspen Snowmass mountains, with an on-property ski concierge, ski storage and complimentary shuttle service.

facts.text: Hotel Jerome typically closes for a period in spring, so guests should confirm seasonal operating dates.
facts.excerpt: Hotel Jerome typically closes for a period in spring, so guests should confirm seasonal operating dates when planning a stay.

facts.text: Hotel Jerome Treks by Moncler Grenoble are guided by an Aspen Center for Environmental Studies expert, with a custom Moncler Grenoble field kit.
facts.excerpt: Led by an Aspen Center for Environmental Studies (ACES) expert and equipped with a custom Moncler Grenoble field kit designed for Hotel Jerome

facts.text: The guest rooms were reimagined, with updated Deluxe King Rooms, Junior Suites and One Bedroom Suites.
facts.excerpt: The newly reimagined guest rooms at Hotel Jerome offer a modern perspective on Western heritage.

facts.text: The Residential Suites have a private elevator entrance, expansive outdoor patios, three bedrooms and over 2,000 square feet.
facts.excerpt: That special something—from private elevator entrance to expansive outdoor patios—plus three bedrooms, over 2,000 square feet, and spectacular mountain views.

facts.text: The hotel is dog-friendly, with a cleaning fee of $100 per stay and a maximum of two pets allowed.
facts.excerpt: There is a cleaning fee of $100 per stay, and a maximum of two pets allowed.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes the property closes in mid April and reopens in late May.
facts.excerpt: Do keep in mind, the property closes in mid April and reopens in late May.

facts.text: Guest rooms have contemporary artwork commissioned for the hotel by regional artists.
facts.excerpt: the contemporary artwork that hangs in each room is commissioned for the hotel by regional artists
